items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-09-01
items.q: And of course, Frank would get out and do his act.

ctx.x: I saw Danny Barker on the street a couple of weeks ago. I hadn't seen him in a long time. Now he's a hell of a storyteller.

Yeah, yeah. Well, anyway, we're getting away from Tony. Did he have dancers then? We talked about him. I can remember. We talked about Lizzy. And of course, Frank would get out and do his act. I don't remember any dances at that time.

Yeah. What was his son-in-law's name? Louis Mitro. D'Amico or something like that. He had a waiter that danced. Joe or something or another. Golly, I'm digging way down deep. He was the doorman at the show bar and is now a dancer. He would go up and work to the freezing room as a waiter on Sunday. And I saw Joe. Joe's got to be my age or maybe a couple of years older. And he went to show bars. And I can remember Joe standing up in front of the 500. Oh, who was the actor and the comedian at the 500? And Joe knew…
